extracted text: The aeronautic aluminum alloy used in this study was the heat treated 4-mm-thick 2024-T351 aluminum alloy. Its nominal chemical composition (by weight%) is Al-6.20Cu-3.38Mg-0.55Mn.
property mapping:
σ0.2 (MPa) = YS [MPa] (yield stress)
σUTS (MPa) = UTS [MPa] (ultimate tensile stress)
ε0.2 (%) = elong [%] (strain at 0.2% offset)
E (MPa) = Young's modulus
UT (J/mm³) = Toughness
abbreviations: T351 refers to a temper designation where T3 means solution heat treated, cold worked, and naturally aged, with 51 indicating stress relief by stretching with minor straightening operations.
